findings.claim: The plan's baseline is not committed. ADR 0015 is staged but not in HEAD (git ls-tree HEAD .okf/decisions/ ends at 0014), and .okf/log.md, .okf/decisions/index.md, .okf/components/devcontainer.md, justfile and .devcontainer/* are staged edits in the primary checkout only. The ticket worktree branches from main HEAD, so it will hold 14 decisions, not 15, and none of the 0015 lines the plan counts. This ticket edits the same three .okf files, so committing the staged work later conflicts with the ticket's merge, and r7 and r8 diff against a merge base that lacks them. The two rules step 4 relies on, manifesto-invariants.md and diagrams-stay-current.md, are gitignored (.gitignore:29 /.claude/rules/*), so they will not exist in the worktree either. Fix: commit the staged work, and either commit or copy in those two rules, before the build starts, and state that as a precondition.

Step 1 points moved docs/ sources at their new homes. Every decision notice is one of these (0003 to 0012 cite git:3ec5d1e:docs/dns.md, openviking.md, vault-2fa.md and postgres-vault-dynamic-creds-spike.md). The three dependent tickets (docs-howto, docs-reference, docs-explanation) delete or rename pages ('something that no longer exists is deleted') and must not write under .okf/. Any okf source that points at such a page goes back to 'source not resolved' as soon as one of them merges, and no ticket owns repairing it. So r2's empty-notices result holds only until the next ticket in this epic merges. Fix: point concept and decision sources at the code or config they describe, not at docs/ pages. Otherwise, give the docs tickets an outcome that keeps .okf notices empty, along with the right to edit .okf sources.

r4's link check matches only relative links (regex \]\(SECTION/). The bundle writes links from the bundle root: 254 of the 261 section links under .okf/ have the form ](/components/x.md). A summary that follows the bundle's style links every section and still fails r4. So the command asserts more than its fails_when ('a section has no link from it'). Fix: accept an optional leading slash, e.g. \]\(/?SECTION/.
Baseline now committed: d6860a3 is on main and HEAD's .okf/decisions/ holds 0015, with the log and devcontainer edits. The plan names just worktree_setup for the SSH key, tfvars and rules.
docs-howto, docs-reference and docs-explanation now repoint .okf sources naming a page they rename or delete, log the touched concepts, and their r2 fails on any notice bundle-wide.
r4's regex is now \]\(/?SECTION/[^)]+\.md, accepting the bundle's root-relative links.

19 Evidence lines across 9 concepts say a ticket's plan and verdicts are in `.loop/archive/` before `5b2ed1b`, but 14 of those tickets were never archived. Their files are under `.loop/plans/`, `.loop/evals/`, `.loop/reflections/` and `.loop/verdicts/` at `48f52e2`, and R8 only ever had a plan (it was a stub, with no verdicts).

minio.md says R10, R11 and R12 'were all still stubs in the loop ledger when 5b2ed1b reset the loop', but R12 was marked dropped in the ledger in a7aa595 (dropped: true), which the paragraph itself says two sentences earlier.
